name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A half-donut gauge with rounded, separated segments, an optional total header, the featured segment in the centre, and a one-row legend. Uses namespace exports: DonutChart.Root.

docs.lead: Segments along a half-donut. The featured segment's value and label fill the centre; pass a total to show a figure above the arc.
docs.usage:
import * as DonutChart from "@/components/ui/donut-chart"

<DonutChart.Root
  items={[{ label: "Category A", value: 10 }, { label: "Category B", value: 55 }]}
  highlighted="Category B"
  total={{ label: "Total", value: 65 }}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: One segment per item. The centre stays bare until a segment is hovered, when its value and label fill the centre and its legend entry gets the pill. Past two segments the colours continue the series ramp. Keep labels short, since the legend is one row.

examples.title: Small segment
examples.description: A very small segment is drawn at a minimum size so it keeps its rounded corners; the others give up the room. The centre and legend still show the real value.
examples.code:
<DonutChart.Root
  items={[
    { label: "Category A", value: 120 },
    { label: "Category B", value: 64 },
    { label: "Category C", value: 1 },
  ]}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: With total
examples.description: Pass total and the header shows above the arc. Pass highlighted and that segment holds the centre and the pill without a hover; hovering another segment takes them over while hovered.
examples.code:
<DonutChart.Root
  items={items}
  highlighted="Category B"
  total={{ label: "Total", value: 65 }}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: With short labels
examples.description: Give an item a shortLabel when its full name won't fit the one-row legend. The legend and centre show the short label; the legend entry's title keeps the full one.
examples.code:
<DonutChart.Root
  items={[
    { label: "Category Alpha (CA)", shortLabel: "CA", value: 18 },
    { label: "Category Beta (CB)", shortLabel: "CB", value: 24 },
    { label: "Category Gamma (CG)", shortLabel: "CG", value: 8 },
  ]}
  highlighted="Category Beta (CB)"
/>

api.name: DonutChart.Root
api.description: The optional header, the arc and the legend. Sized for a 352px card.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; shortLabel?: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: Segments along the arc, left to right. shortLabel, when given, replaces label in the legend and centre; label stays as the legend entry's title and screen-reader text

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Label of the segment to feature, matched against label, not shortLabel. Omitted or null leaves the centre bare. A hovered segment is featured as well, and takes the centre while hovered

props.name: total
props.description: A caption over a figure above the arc. Shown only when passed

props.name: unit
props.description: What the values count, read out with each legend entry for a screen reader
